angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 67,830,750 km at 1967.80 pc = 0.46 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RW Cam: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1967.8 +/- 139.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1967.8 +/- 139.7 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.7133 +/- 0.1371 mas (same row, RUWE 8.01), 5.2 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 97.5 +/- 7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RW Cam: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 97.5 +/- 7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 67,830,750 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5125 +/- 253 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 136, Name='RW Cam', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 253 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 136, Name='RW Cam', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 253 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
